examples.title: Create a Dissolve node
examples.code:
# Create the node and keep a reference to it.
dissolve = nuke.createNode("Dissolve")

provenance.editorial_note: Node class is present in the locked scanner dataset; Foundry toolbar source is used where the class is exposed in the standard toolbar.

examples.title: Connect foreground and background inputs
examples.code:
# Connect two image streams to the node.
dissolve = nuke.createNode("Dissolve")
dissolve.setInput(0, foreground)
dissolve.setInput(1, background)

provenance.editorial_note: Generic two-input graph pattern; exact A/B semantic labels remain defined by the scanner metadata.

examples.code:
# Limit which channels the node processes.
dissolve = nuke.createNode("Dissolve")
dissolve["channels"].setValue("rgba")
examples.title: Set channels

status_reason: Remaining-queue functional editorial pass completed. Examples combine the locked scanner's node/knob data with documented Nuke Python creation, graph-wiring, and inspection patterns. Node-specific interactive workflows are not invented.
